title: Budapest Operetta Conquers the World
grammar: Subjunctive after verbs of fear and precaution (attól tart, hogy / nehogy)
goal: I can say what the comic roles did in operetta (szubrett, táncoskomikus).
I can use nehogy + subjunctive after verbs of fear and care (Féltek, nehogy ...; Vigyázott, nehogy ...).
I can name the main operetta roles and the composers Lehár Ferenc and Kálmán Imre.
